content.short: Paradigm CTF is an online competition for smart contract hackers organized by Paradigm.
content.description: Paradigm CTF is an online competition for smart contract hackers organized by Paradigm, an investment fund that supports Web3 and crypto companies. The competition features a suite of challenges designed by leading experts in the field. In each challenge, participants try to hack a smart contract or discover another non-obvious way to solve it, testing their security instincts, analytical thinking, and creative problem-solving abilities. Participants build hands-on expertise in smart contract security and exploitation techniques while engaging with a community of security-minded peers.
